name: publicWeb_getEventTrailTypes
description: Returns the owning kennel's PackTrack trail-type config JSON for an event, so the GetPositions function can bundle it into the position payload (full fetch only). Unauthenticated; no PII.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal HC.Event.id (the id PackTrack keys positions by), not PublicEventId.

rowsets.name: TrailTypesConfig
rowsets.description: Single row with the kennel's trail-type config JSON; the value is NULL when the kennel has no customisation (clients fall back to built-in defaults). 0 rows when the event is not found. A { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } envelope is returned only when @eventId is null/empty.

columns.name: trailTypesConfigJson
columns.description: Per-kennel merge-by-value trail-type config JSON (HC.Kennel.TrailTypesConfigJson), or NULL.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
